coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across six core products (Activepieces, Power Automate, Node-RED, Prismatic, Windmill, Latenode) plus n8n for market context. Coverage includes: (1) Official products (homepages, docs, pricing, changelogs), (2) Funding records via Crunchbase/Tracxn/PitchBook, (3) Third-party reviews (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius), (4) Analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant for low-code, Gartner Peer Insights, market sizing via TrendX/BusinessResearchInsights), (5) Direct product comparisons (Boolean & Beyond, Automation Atlas, Zapier blog, Latenode blog), (6) Developer community perspectives (HN, Medium, GitHub stars), (7) HCI/usability research (ArXiv papers on UI automation complexity, enterprise deployment challenges), (8) Integration ecosystem evidence (Zapier 9000+ apps, Activepieces MCP 400+ servers, n8n 400+ nodes). Tier assignment: Official sources and press releases T0; docs/API/announcements T1; analyst reports and review aggregates T2; practitioner comparisons, blogs, Medium essays T3. Deduplication applied across multiple sources covering same product announcements. Notable gaps deferred: specific TechCrunch reviews of Power Automate, detailed Gartner Magic Quadrant PDF analysis (paywalled), Reddit/HN discussion threads (limited discovery), academic HCI research on specific platforms (beyond general low-code usability papers).
